site.title: {project} - Ukwabelana Ngamafayela Okungalawulwa Maphakathi
site.description: {project} yisoftware ye-peer-to-peer yokwabelana ngamafayela, eyakhiwe phezu kwezobuchwepheshe besimanje besingalawulwa maphakathi.
site.ogDescription: Ukwabelana ngamafayela kwe-peer-to-peer phezu kwezobuchwepheshe besimanje besingalawulwa maphakathi. Akukho iseva ephakathi. Akukho ndawo eyodwa yokuhluleka.

hero.subtitle: Isizukulwane esilandelayo sokwabelana ngamafayela kwe-peer-to-peer
hero.description: Phezu kwezobuchwepheshe besimanje besingalawulwa maphakathi. Akukho iseva ephakathi. Akukho ndawo eyodwa yokuhluleka.

about.title: Mayelana
about.intro: {project} yiplatform yesizukulwane esilandelayo sokwabelana ngamafayela kwe-peer-to-peer eyakhiwe phezu kwezobuchwepheshe besimanje besingalawulwa maphakathi. Ihlanganisa ikhasi lokusebenzisa elilula ne-architecture engalawulwa maphakathi ngokugcwele, iletha ukwabelana ngedata okuphephile nokwethembekile ngaphandle kwesidingo segunya elimaphakathi. Lo mklamo uvulekile, usatshalaliswa ngaphansi kwe-{license}.

decentralized.title: Inethiwekhi engalawulwa maphakathi ngokupheleleyo
decentralized.description: Akukho iseva ephakathi, akukho ndawo eyodwa yokuhluleka. Abasebenzisi bathola futhi balayisha okuqukethwe ngokuqondile komunye nomunye, ngaphandle kokuncika kunoma yikuphi i-indexer, isilandeli, noma idatabase ephakathi.

accessControl.title: Ukulawula okuncane kwe-access
accessControl.description: Noma ngubani angaqala inethiwekhi yakhe mahhala ngemithetho yakhe. Ngaphakathi kwenethiwekhi ngayinye, chaza izindima zomsebenzisi: umnikazi, umphathi, umshicileli, ulawuli nomlayishi. Lawula ngokuncane ukuthi ubani angashicilela, alawule, futhi alayishe okuqukethwe.

ui.title: Ikhasi lomsebenzisi lekhwalithi ephezulu
ui.description: Ikhasi le-media center elihlanzekile nelimnandi, lakhelwe i-desktop, i-TV namaplatform aphethwa. Ukuhamba okulula ngebhodi lokushaya, ingoso, isidlalo noma ulawulwa lwesibukweli. Abasebenzisi abathuthukile bangagijimisa lesi software njengeseva yefayela engenanhloko ngekhasi lomugqa womyalelo.

dataFormat.title: Ifomathi yedata efundwa ngumuntu
dataFormat.description: Ifomathi yedata ye-LISH yakhiwe phezu kwe-JSON, okwenza kube lula ukudala, ukufunda nokuqonda. Yabelana ngokuqukethwe kwakho ngemetadata ehlanzekile nesobala leyo noma ngubani angabhekisisa kalula.

security.title: Ubumfihlo nokuphepha
security.description: Konke ukuxhumana kwe-peer-to-peer kucashile, kuqinisekisa ukuthi idata yakho ihlala iyimfihlo ngesikhathi sokudluliselwa. Abasebenzisi bangacasha ngemuva kwe-VPN ngokweseka kokungaziwa okwengeziwe. {project} iyahlonipha ubumfihlo bakho ngokuyiklamiwe.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Lesi software siyatholakala ku-Windows, Linux nakuMacOS. Sisebenzise kunoma yiluphi idivayisi oyikhethayo.

download.title: Layisha
download.description: Thola {project} kwiplatform yakho. Konke ukulayisha kumahhala futhi kuvulekile.

macos.title: Inothi elibalulekile kubasebenzisi be-macOS:
macos.intro: I-macOS Gatekeeper izovimba ama-app angasayindiwe/anganotarayizwanga alayishwe kwi-internet, ngephutha {error}.
macos.runCommand: Ngemuva kokulayisha i-DMG noma i-ZIP, ngaphambi kokuvula i-app, sebenzisa lo myalelo kwi-Terminal:
macos.explanation: Lokhu kuzosusa isici se-quarantine futhi kuvumele i-app igijime.
